novelty.justification: The core novelty route is a proposed mechanism and measurement: the claim says belief flips are an "abrupt threshold event in the residual stream," exhibit asymmetric "hysteresis," and can be controlled through a linear "belief-stability" direction. Searches using "LLM belief revision sequential evidence flip threshold," "multi-turn sycophancy turn of flip," "belief updating residual stream geometry," and "activation steering belief revision" identify SYCON Bench (2025) as the closest behavioral work because it already measures Turn of Flip under sustained pressure, while Transformers Represent Belief State Geometry in Their Residual Stream (2024) and When Truth Is Overridden (2025) supply the residual-stream and mechanistic-sycophancy precedents; BayesBench (2026) also studies belief trajectories under accumulated evidence. Moving from these works to internal flip sharpness, anchor-versus-parametric-prior hysteresis, and causal control of the update threshold is a substantive multi-step integration, but it is a natural mechanistic extension of already-studied flip dynamics plus standard difference-of-means activation steering rather than an entirely new paradigm.
